meta.title: Sessions
meta.description: The training sessions you plan for your fighters.
meta.newDescription: Plan a training session for one of your fighters.

planner.aside: One session is planned for one fighter you coach. The fighter confirms when they did it; you see the result here. Times show in the session’s time zone.

upcoming.title: No upcoming sessions
upcoming.body: Plan a session for one of your fighters. It appears here and in their training.

history.title: No past sessions yet
history.body: Completed, cancelled and past sessions appear here.

completed.title: No completed sessions yet
completed.body: Sessions your fighters confirmed appear here.

cancelled.title: No cancelled sessions
cancelled.body: Sessions you or the system cancelled appear here.

unavailable.title: Sessions aren’t available yet
unavailable.body: Planning training opens together with coaching fighters, once the coach data rules and what fighters agree to share are published. Nothing is hidden from you: there is simply nothing to show yet.

failed.title: We couldn’t load your sessions.
failed.body: Check your connection and try again.

fighter.label: Fighter
fighter.fixed: The fighter of a session can’t change.

title.label: Title
title.invalid: Enter a title of up to 80 characters.

time.label: Start time
time.window: Choose a start between yesterday and one year from now.
time.invalid: This start time can’t be used. Check the date, time and time zone.

zone.label: Time zone
zone.invalid: This time zone isn’t supported. Choose another one.

duration.label: Duration
duration.invalid: Enter a whole number of minutes from 5 to 600.

notes.label: Notes for the fighter · optional
notes.hint: Up to 2,000 characters. The fighter sees them.

gap.title: This time doesn’t exist on that day.
gap.body: The clocks in {zone} skip this time when daylight saving starts. Choose another start time.

overlap.title: This time happens twice on that day.
overlap.body: The clocks in {zone} go back and repeat it. Choose which {time}:
overlap.required: Choose which of the two times you mean.

failed.title: We couldn’t save the session.
failed.create: Nothing changed. Check your connection and try again; trying again never creates a second session.
failed.edit: Nothing changed. Check your connection and try again.

conflict.title: This session can’t be changed any more.
conflict.body: The fighter completed it, or it was cancelled. Your changes were not saved.

unavailable.title: You can’t plan for this fighter any more.
unavailable.body: The coaching relationship ended or isn’t available. Nothing was saved.

noFighters.title: No fighters to plan for yet
noFighters.body: You can plan sessions for fighters who accepted your invitation. Invite a fighter from Fighters first.

form.aside: The start is saved as an exact moment in the time zone you choose, so it stays right across daylight-saving changes and for a fighter in another country.

aside.planned: Planned sessions can be edited or cancelled until the fighter completes them.
aside.completed: The fighter confirmed this session. Completed sessions can’t be edited or cancelled.
aside.cancelled: Cancelled sessions stay in history. To train again, create a new session.

missing.title: This session isn’t available
missing.body: It may belong to a fighter you no longer coach, or the link is wrong.
missing.aside: Sessions of fighters you no longer coach are not shown.

failed.title: We couldn’t load this session.
failed.body: Check your connection and try again.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this session?
cancelDialog.body: {name} sees it as cancelled. A cancelled session can’t be planned again; create a new one instead.
cancelDialog.bodyUnnamed: The fighter sees it as cancelled. A cancelled session can’t be planned again; create a new one instead.
cancelDialog.failed: We couldn’t cancel the session. Nothing changed. Try again.
cancelDialog.changed: This session can’t be cancelled any more: the fighter completed it.
cancelDialog.unavailable: This session isn’t available any more.
